claims: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the moon.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed lunar mission in over 50 years.
The Artemis II crew traveled in the Orion capsule.
NASA's Reid Wiseman is the commander of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover is the pilot of the Artemis II crew.
Christina Koch is a mission specialist on Artemis II.
Jeremy Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency is a mission specialist on Artemis II.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the moon and back.
The Artemis II mission tests the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission tests the Orion capsule.
Artemis II is the first time a woman (Christina Koch) will travel to deep space.
Artemis II is the first time a non-American (Jeremy Hansen) will travel to deep space.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the moon since Apollo 17 in 1972.
The Artemis II crew was launched by the NASA Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II launch was from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
A landing mission is now targeted for 2028, according to Forbes.
